Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The agent failed to extract the correct data from the search results. While the search results clearly stated "Roy White had the most walks for the Yankees in 1977, with 75 walks" (from StatMuse), the WebSurfer agent did not explicitly confirm this finding or note the source in its report. Instead, it simply reported the search was performed. More critically, in the subsequent steps, the agent relied on this initial finding without verifying it against the team page or other sources before proceeding to extract the AB value. This lack of explicit confirmation and verification led to the eventual error where the agent reported 606 AB instead of the correct 519 AB, as the initial walk count (75) was actually incorrect (the true leader was likely someone else or the number was wrong, leading to the wrong player being targeted). The agent's failure to rigorously validate the "most walks" claim before proceeding to extract the AB for that specific player was the root cause of the final incorrect answer.
